- Vendor packet (W-9/W-8 as applicable) and banking instructions for ACH/Wire

- Any internal vendor portal where we should register as a supplier

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Evan/Procurement: confirm payment route preference and preferred vendor onboarding method (portal vs. emailed packet) by EOD Monday 6/21
2) If PO preferred: share a sample PO and procurement contact so our finance team can set billing terms
3) If marketplace preferred: share the account/ordering contact so we can confirm listing and quoting cadence

Ben is cc'd for any finance/banking questions; Marissa will coordinate the onboarding timeline once we see the packet returned.

Hi Soojin (and team),

Thanks for the clear recap — the demo was helpful. A few answers from procurement: 

- We prefer to use a PO with net-30 terms for pilot contracts (Citrine standard).
- We do have a vendor portal (Coupa) but it often requires our vendors to be pre-registered. Procurement will accept emailed vendor packets in parallel while they add you to Coupa.
- We'll need Redwood to complete the W-9 (we're US-based). Could you confirm who on your side signs the vendor packet?

Two quick asks from our side: 
1) Can Redwood provide banking details and remittance instructions for ACH payments? We typically send a PO and then schedule payments against invoices.
2) For marketplace: we might prefer marketplace licensing for certain teams later, but for the initial pilot we want a direct relationship to keep billing simple.

I'll attach our vendor setup questionnaire (PDF) — you can return the completed forms to procurement@citrinehealth.com. If it's helpful, I'll introduce our procurement lead (Rebecca) on the next reply.

Thanks,
Evan Miller
Director, Product Strategy
Citrine Health
